Priya: Quick proposal: run a split on pricing CTA language + FAQ blurbs this week. test 'Start free' vs 'Reserve capacity' and two FAQ microcopies (predictability vs discount+SLA).
Evan: +1. add a tiny inline cost calculator (50k / 200k tokens presets) and a 1-question microsurvey after CTA: P0/P1/P2. keeps routing simple.
Jules: Routing rules: committed click OR microsurvey=P2 -> sales.high_priority; P1 -> sales.medium; freemium -> marketing.nurture. Add param `pricing_variant`.
Aria: I'll implement GTM flags and GA event: `pricing_cta_click` with variant field. also mobile: show compact calc callout that expands.
MarketingBot: Reminder: register experiment as pricing-quicktest-2026, hypothesis=committed-cta-increases MQL quality, metrics=click_to_lead, lead_tier.
Priya: timeline: PR for calc by Mon, GTM + modal by Wed, internal rollout Thurs. Evan/Jules please confirm handoff for Sales playbook bullets.
Evan: i'll draft 3 bullet playbook and share in #sales-review by Tue.
Jules: wiring webhook for inbound routing. will gzip payload and include scored_flag for P1/P2.
Priya: perfect. will post final QA checklist and test URL when GTM is staged. :rocket:
